tbesh_html:
1) to sink, sink down, subside
1a) (Qal) to sink
1b) (Niphal) to sink, collapse
1c)(Hiphil) to sink down, cause to settle

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to subside; by implication, to be overflowed, cease; causatively, to abate, subdue
strongs_1890.kjv_def: make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.
